children: Analog Devices issued $3.0 billion of senior unsecured notes in a four-part underwritten public offering, with maturities in 2029, 2031, 2033 and 2036. The tranches carry coupons of 5.10%, 5.35%, 5.60% and 5.75%, respectively, and were sold under an effective shelf registration. The company also executed a Supplemental Indenture with its trustee to govern the new notes, which include customary covenants and events of default. The offering broadens Analog Devices’ fixed-rate, long-dated funding and enhances financial flexibility.
